paragraphs: MD Ally sells a virtual response tier that public safety systems and payors add to 911 and EMS services. The pathway is for patients with low-acuity health concerns better cared for via telehealth. Dispatchers and first responders use it to connect people deemed non-emergent to telehealth, in-network resources and social services in real-time.

The home page names Lee County, FL as a partner, under a heading about expanding public safety services. The same story says it will save costs for Lee County and its residents and reduce the time to see a physician.

quote.text: MD Ally partners with Public Safety and payers to expand the scope of 911 and EMS services and get patients to “the Right Care, at the Right Time, and in the Right Place.”
